## Effects control
The effects control is presented to the user through the Home Assistant dashboard as a dropdown menu or list selector. Users can choose from available lighting effects (such as "Rainbow", "Pulse", "Strobe", etc.) using this UI element. Once an effect is selected, it is immediately applied to the AudioLeds device.
- **Dropdown Selector:** The main interface is a dropdown menu labeled "Effect", listing all supported effects. - **Live Preview (optional):** Some setups may show a small preview or animation next to the selector, indicating the chosen effect. - **Immediate Feedback:** When the user selects an effect, the change is sent to the device and the lights update in real time. - **Additional Controls:** Depending on the effect, sliders or input fields may appear for parameters like speed, brightness, or color.
This control is typically found in the device's entity card within the Home Assistant UI, making it easy for users to experiment and switch between effects.
